questions.prompt: After the PSG, the patient asks, 'Do I have sleep apnea and what pressure do I need?' What is the best response?
options: Tell the patient the diagnosis based on what you saw
Say nothing except that the study was normal
Give a pressure recommendation from the overnight screen
Explain that the physician will interpret the scored study and provide diagnosis/treatment recommendations; avoid giving a diagnosis
questions.answer: Explain that the physician will interpret the scored study and provide diagnosis/treatment recommendations; avoid giving a diagnosis
questions.rationale: The technologist supports education but should not provide diagnosis or prescription outside scope.
questions.whyTricky: The trap is over-answering because the patient asks directly.
questions.coachBobNote: Be helpful without crossing the line.
